resources.string: Suggested foods

Get up to three individual food portions for a selected meal and allowance. These are alternatives, not a complete balanced meal or medical diet plan. Each portion has its own calorie limit. Suggestions use a snapshot of current goals and logs; regenerate after changes. Current profile goals are used even when viewing an earlier diary date. Preferences and nutrient coverage affect ranking; exercise calories are not added to your allowance.
